steps.title: Create routes/gallery-upload-routes.js
steps.task: The file MUST begin with a JSDoc block comment containing a line exactly '@ssot docs/products/universal-overlay/PRODUCT_HOME.md' (mandatory, checked by a commit gate). Create a new Express route module exporting a function createGalleryUploadRoutes({ requireKey, commitManyToGitHub, logger }) that returns an express.Router(). The router has one route: router.post('/upload', requireKey, async (req, res) => {...}). Handler behavior: read { files } from req.body, where files is expected to be an array of objects each shaped { filename: string, base64: string }. If files is missing, not an array, or empty, respond 400 { ok:false, error:'files array is required' }. Validate each entry has a non-empty filename and non-empty base64 string; if any entry fails validation, respond 400 { ok:false, error:'each file needs filename and base64' } without calling commitManyToGitHub. Build a fileEntries array for commitManyToGitHub where each entry is { path: `data/card-photos/${filename}`, content: base64, encoding: 'base64' } (use the entry's own filename, sanitize it by stripping any '/' or '..' segments to prevent path traversal -- reject the whole request with 400 { ok:false, error:'invalid filename' } if any filename contains '/' or '..' after trimming). Call commitManyToGitHub(fileEntries, a commit message like `[gallery-upload] ${fileEntries.length} photo(s)`, 'main') inside a try/catch. On success, respond 200 { ok:true, count: fileEntries.length, paths: fileEntries.map(f => f.path) }. On failure (commitManyToGitHub throws), log via logger?.error?.({ err: err.message }, '[GALLERY-UPLOAD] commit failed') if logger is provided, then respond 500 { ok:false, error: err.message }. Default export an object { createGalleryUploadRoutes }. No other routes, no other files.
non_goals: a new commit mechanism -- reuse commitManyToGitHub only
